sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:56

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:56:1
items.html:
One Partzuf — the male and the Nukva within it, etc., MA and BON at its right and at its left, which are the discernment of male and Nukva: And you must remember what is written in the Inner Light above (Part 4, Chapter 5, Section 2), in the explanation of the words right and left, front and back. For two kinds of lights are discerned in the wholeness of the Partzuf: the first is the light of Hochma; the second is the light of Hassadim. And a degree that is lacking Hochma is called by the name “back,” and one that is lacking Hassadim is called by the name “left.” And you already know that Nukva means she who bears the deficiency, and male means he who completes the deficiency that is in the Nukva. And by this you will understand that when the male and Nukva are of the bestowal of Hassadim, they are discerned in the standing of right and left; and when the male and Nukva are of the bestowal of Hochma, they are called by the name front and back. For he who completes the Hassadim is called “right,” and he who completes Hochma is called “front.”
Also know that in the GAR of every phase there is no deficiency of the discernment of Hochma there, for the deficiency of Hochma derives from the point of the restriction, and the three first ones mean that they are above the point of the restriction that is in the screen, as is known. But there can be there a deficiency of Hassadim. And even this deficiency of Hassadim is possible only in the ZAT of Bina alone; but in the GAR of Bina, the Hassadim never cease from there, for Bina is the root of all the Hassadim, as is known, in the Bina of the ten Sefirot of the direct light. Only her ZAT, which expanded from her through the cutting off of her posterior, as above, can be lacking Hassadim.
But in the two lower Partzufim of Atzilut, which are ZON, the matter of the deficiency of Hochma applies in them, since they are of the discernment of below the Tabur of AK and below the Tabur of AA, as is known. Therefore the standings of the Nukvin of AA and AVI are at the left, and the standings of the two Nukvin of ZA, called Leah and Rachel, are at the posterior of ZA. For the Nukvin of ZA, being lacking Hochma, their standing is therefore discerned as the discernment of “back,” as above. But the Nukvin of GAR, being lacking only Hassadim, their standing is discerned as the discernment of “left.”
And the root of these matters is brought in the Zohar, Vayikra, page 4a, in the secret of the verse, “Eat, O friends; drink, yea, be drunk, O beloved”: “The secret of the matter: ‘Eat, O friends’ — the upper ones; ‘drink, yea, be drunk, O beloved’ — the lower ones.” Rabbi Elazar said to him: “Who are the upper ones, and who are the lower ones?” He said to him: “You have asked well. This is the upper place, where they are in unity and joy and are never separated; these are called friends, as it is said, ‘And a river went out of Eden’ — and Eden and that river are never separated, and are found forever in desire, unity, and joy. ‘Drink, yea, be drunk, O beloved’ — these are the lower ones, who are called beloved at known times, and that we have already established. Come and see: of the upper ones, eating is written in them without drinking. Why? He who has skins of wine needs eating, and because preserved wine rests there, eating is written of them. And of the lower ones, who need drinking, drinking is written of them.” End of quote.
It follows that the coupling of the upper AVI is in the secret of the abundance of Hassadim, which is called eating, namely “Eat, O friends”; and it is the coupling of AVI that never ceases, in the secret of Eden and the river. And the reason for the matter is that he who has skins of wine needs eating, and because preserved wine rests there, eating is written of them. Explanation: the illumination of Hochma is called by the name “wine preserved in its grapes.” And since this illumination of Hochma always rests, even in the Nukva, who is Bina — for she is the very self of Hochma, from the very substance of her emanation — there is therefore no discernment of coupling on the illumination of Hochma there, for the Nukva is not lacking this at all, so as to need the male to complete her; rather, she is lacking Hassadim, and for this she needs the male, who is the secret of Eden, to bestow upon her the light of Hassadim, which is called “Eat, O friends.” But ZON, who lack the illumination of Hochma, therefore need the coupling of drinking, which means the illumination of Hochma. And this is what he says: “And of the lower ones, who need drinking, drinking is written of them.” Meaning that the lower male and Nukva, who are ZON, are thirsty for the illumination of Hochma, and therefore their coupling is in the secret of “drink, yea, be drunk, O beloved.” And it is now explained that the coupling of male and Nukva in GAR is possible only in the bestowal of Hassadim, for it is impossible that a Nukva of GAR will be lacking Hochma, for then they would not be called GAR. Therefore the standing of the male and Nukva of GAR is discerned only in right and left, and not in front and back.
And one should not ask that since the whole source of the light of Hassadim in the ten Sefirot of the direct light is Bina, how can she then be lacking Hassadim, to the point of needing Aba. However, you know that Aba of Atzilut is the degree of the Bina of the new MA, and Ima of Atzilut is the ZAT of Hochma and Bina of Nekudim. For Atik took the GAR of HB of Nekudim, namely the discernments of Galgalta, Einayim, and Nikvey Einayim, which are Keter, Hochma, and the GAR of Bina of HB of Nekudim — Atik took them; and not only that, but even the light of Hesed of the ZAT of Bina also remained in Atik, and nothing remained to Ima except the ZAT of Hochma and the ZAT of Bina, which are from Gevura and below. For after the AHP of HB descended in the discernment of posterior to the ZAT of Nekudim, they could not take with them the light of Hesed of Bina, for the GAR of Bina drew it to them, in the secret of “for He desires mercy,” as the ARI writes in Mati [reaching] and Lo Mati [not reaching]; see there.
It follows that in the Ima of Nekudim there is no discernment of the light of Hassadim, and therefore she needs Aba to bestow Hassadim upon her, for since he is the degree of the Bina of MA, he has the GAR of Bina, which are the source of all the Hassadim. And he bestows them to the Ima of Atzilut; however, they are never separated, for their coupling does not cease, as above. And see in the Mevo Shearim, Gate 4, Part 2, Chapter 11, and in Shaar HaKavanot, the discourses of Yom Kippur, discourse 2.
Therefore, also the Nukva of AA, who is also of the discernment of the AHP of the posterior of the Keter of Nekudim — as above, for Atik took the GAR of Keter, which are Galgalta, Einayim, and Nikvey Einayim of Keter, namely Keter, Hochma, and the GAR of Bina, with the light of Hesed of Bina that always remains in the GAR of Bina, as above; Atik took all these from the Keter of Nekudim, and nothing remained to the Nukva of AA except the ZAT of Bina, from Gevura and below, with the ZON of Keter. It follows that the Nukva of AA is also lacking Hassadim from the discernment of Keter, and therefore the Nukva of AA must also receive the light of Hassadim from the male, who has a complete degree of Hochma of the new MA. Therefore there is male and Nukva of the discernment of right and left also in AA, except that they are in one Partzuf, because he is the discernment of a root, in which a separate Nukva cannot be, as above.
